performance_scope: Batch 1 greedy generation, dynamic KV cache, two-token untimed warmup. First-token time includes prefill. Decode time includes model forward, argmax and CUDA synchronization; excludes loading, tokenization, CPU logit copies/hashing, finite checks, token.item, EOS handling and output. This is warm compute timing, not end-to-end service throughput.
reserved_memory_note: Allocator cache is released at round boundaries; identical per-case two-token warmup. Peaks include packed model.

measurement_details.warmup: Per prompt up to two tokens outside timing; EOS may stop warmup earlier.
measurement_details.pooled_rate_formula: sum(generated_token_count - 1) / sum(step_seconds[1:]) over the eight prompts.
measurement_details.first_token: Includes prompt prefill; separate from post-first-token rate.
measurement_details.EOS: Generation stops at EOS and counts emitted EOS. Four prompts reach the 32-token cap without EOS.
measurement_details.memory: PyTorch allocated/reserved peaks include the packed model and are not whole-card NVML usage.
not_measured: end-to-end chat latency or service throughput

semantic_review.scope: Manual reading of previously used development prompts; not a capability score.
semantic_review.conclusion: The fast implementation preserves all recorded answers, including conceptual and instruction-following failures. No quality restoration claim.

cases.reason: Confuses quantization with saving parameters/checkpoints; reaches the token limit without EOS.
Mentions lower-bit weights and activations reducing memory, but makes an unqualified accuracy-preservation claim and reaches the token limit.
Names Beijing but continues with an explanation despite the city-name-only instruction; also makes an unsupported largest-city assertion.
Answers only OK and ends with EOS.
Describes lower-precision weights but is cut off at the 32-token cap without EOS.
Translates Good morning to Chinese and ends with EOS.

provenance.source_hash_scope: Exact runtime file bytes. tokenizer-files.json intentionally preserves CRLF; source-files.json itself may have canonical LF without changing the parsed mapping.
provenance.privacy: Only model output, timing and public source identities retained; launch plans, private paths and machine identifiers omitted.
